correctness.rationale: A realizer assigns every unmarked point a pair of insertion cuts. For each marked i the cuts (i−1,p_i) and (i,p_i−1) have exactly identical comparison signature; these are m distinct edges forming a forest, yielding at most (m+1)^2−m nonparameter signatures. The antichain realizes all one-sided intervals and all-incomparable signature, giving equality; parameter equality types add m. The actual decoded verifier enumerated all permutations m<=8 and prints VERIFY_OK. The symbolic proof, not finite testing, covers all sizes.
